cases.setup: Funded current delivery with deadline T.
expect: After T: flag cannot reverse approval.
cases.red_check: Fail if the deadline comparison admits a flag at T, or rejects a valid flag before T.

cases.setup: Separate copies of a funded delivery immediately before T.
cases.expect: One consistent transition wins. If the timely flag wins, revision and both approval paths stop; no release occurs.
cases.red_check: Fail if both transitions succeed, a held case releases funds, or the stored state contradicts the winning transition.

actions: Race a flag against replacement of the current version.
cases.expect: Only the current funded delivery can be flagged. A successful case remains attached to the correct version and evidence.
cases.red_check: Fail if a stale version identifier freezes or approves a different version.

actions: Reload separate client and artist sessions.
Attempt revision, manual approval and scheduled release.
Request original and licence through normal access paths.
cases.expect: Both participants see the held status. Blocked transitions remain blocked. Original and licence remain locked.
cases.red_check: Fail if protection exists only in the screen, disappears after reload, or permits direct file access.

actions: Open and decide a case as client, artist, unrelated participant, designated reviewer and participating reviewer.
cases.expect: Only the designated nonparticipating reviewer can decide. Review evidence includes the watermarked preview, process images and client explanation. A ruling records a short explanation; dispute explanations remain private.
cases.red_check: Fail if hiding controls is the only authorization check, a participant can decide their own case, or explanations appear publicly.

cases.setup: A held case with more than one delivery version.
actions: Dismiss the flag with an explanation.
cases.expect: The flagged version receives approval, original access, a personal-use licence and simulated artist release.
cases.red_check: Fail if dismissal approves the latest version instead of the flagged version, starts a refund, or leaves approval benefits unavailable.

actions: Request every delivery version through normal client file paths, including previously known URLs.
Check licence access and artist access.
cases.expect: Client in-app access to all delivery versions is revoked and no licence is granted. Artist access to their own work remains.
cases.red_check: Fail if only the current original is blocked, historical previews remain accessible in-app, or the artist loses their submitted work.

cases.setup: An upheld case with known test payment and full paid amount.
actions: Deliver confirmation for a partial amount.
Deliver valid full-refund confirmation for the matching payment.
cases.expect: Display “Reembolso pendente” until matching full-refund confirmation. Only the valid confirmation completes the refund.
cases.red_check: Fail if request acceptance, a partial refund or an unrelated payment confirmation marks the case refunded.

cases.expect: Each failure leaves a recoverable pending case with files locked. Recovery can complete the full refund without release.
cases.red_check: Fail if failure unlocks files, marks refund complete, releases funds or makes recovery impossible.

actions: Make provider refund succeed but lose the local response.
Replay refund requests and duplicate notifications.
cases.expect: Reconciliation recognizes the existing refund. Replays produce no second financial effect.
cases.red_check: Fail if a timeout triggers a blind second refund or duplicate notifications change counts or financial outcomes.

actions: Submit concurrent uphold and dismiss decisions.
Attempt approval or release while refund is pending and after confirmation.
cases.expect: One ruling wins consistently. A case can refund or release, never both.
cases.red_check: Fail if concurrent decisions produce conflicting terminal states or any execution produces both refund and release.

same_client_paid_commissions: B: delivered, repeated revisions, multiple versions, approved
D: delivered, flag upheld, later refunded

cases.red_check: Fail if refunds reduce originally-paid counts, pending flags count as rejection, undelivered commissions enter rate denominators, or versions and repeated revisions inflate counts.

cases.setup: One artist has two offers. One offer has a commission with several versions, repeated revisions and replayed events; the other has a separate commission.
actions: Read each offer's reputation before and after event replay.
cases.expect: Each commission counts once in its applicable offer. Events and versions do not multiply counts or leak between offers.
cases.red_check: Fail if counting delivery rows or event rows changes reputation.

actions: Read rates with zero eligible delivered commissions.
Read artist on-time availability for legacy commissions without agreed delivery dates.
cases.expect: Zero-denominator rates show “Sem histórico”. Artist on-time rate shows “Sem prazo de entrega registrado” while agreed delivery dates are absent. Review deadlines do not substitute for artist delivery dates.
cases.red_check: Fail if an empty rate displays 0% or 100%, or the 72-hour review window is used to calculate artist punctuality.

actions: Inspect artist and client profiles and commission/artist selection screens.
Use desktop and narrow widths in Brazilian Portuguese.
cases.expect: Required counts and separate rates remain readable, rates show numerator and denominator, flags raised and upheld stay distinct, and dispute explanations remain private.
cases.red_check: Fail if facts exist only in backend responses, narrow layouts hide denominators, or public reputation exposes explanations.

limitations: Read only spec.md and interfaces.txt in the packet. No network, collaboration, external resources or writes were used.
These are designed checks, not executed tests. The interface lists flows and a synthetic clock but supplies no callable contracts, implementation or test harness.
The specification is draft revision 0.1 and identifies reviewer access and reputation definitions as awaiting Nabo’s decision.
Timestamp precision, authoritative clock, transaction ordering and stale-request behavior are unspecified. T−1 ms requires equivalent supported clock precision.
Artist completed-commission semantics are not defined precisely enough to assign exact counts for legacy, held, dismissed and refunded commissions.
The on-time formula and behavior for mixed dated and undated commissions are unspecified.
Reviewer evidence retention and access after client revocation are not fully specified.
Provider confirmation authenticity, reconciliation mechanism and retry contract are not supplied. Actual sandbox refund behavior requires separate observation; unobserved success must remain pending.
Browser-displayed images cannot be recalled. Revocation checks cover subsequent in-app access.
The full suite, typecheck, optimized build and real-screen checks cannot be run from this packet.
